independent_runtime.author_validator_result: PASS (read-only replay; insufficient to cover the findings below)

preserved.next_module: Choose the right research path with three informational panels

findings.P0-01: At 768px and 390px, clicking Menu changes neither aria-expanded nor visible navigation. There is no .mobile-menu, no eight-item mobile navigation surface, no terminal RFQ in that menu, and no accessible Resources aria-current page node. Only the breadcrumb remains as an accessible nav.
findings.P1-01: The primary CTA computes to rgb(0,169,157) with rgb(6,43,91) text, rather than the active filled-primary contract #008078 with white label.
findings.P1-02: At 390px H1 has a 380px layout width inside a 300px text column and is visually compressed with transform matrix(0.85,0,0,1,0,0). The declared 36px value therefore masks a page-private compressed responsive treatment.
findings.P1-03: The decorative illustration wrapper is an exposed aside with aria-label=Decorative research-path illustration; only its nested SVG is aria-hidden. Decorative media must not add an accessibility-tree landmark/name.
findings.P2-01: Binding says the decorative illustration is visible only above 900px, while source hides it through 1023px. The required <=900 behavior is safe, but the 901–1023 implementation does not match the claimed breakpoint.
